scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,server,client "npm:watch -w src/shared" "npm:dev -w src/server" "npm:dev -w src/client"
scripts.dev:client: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w src/client
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w src/server
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w src/server && npm run build -w src/client
scripts.build:client: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w src/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w src/server && npm run typecheck -w src/client
scripts.build:server: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w src/server
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm test -w src/shared && npm test -w src/client && npm test -w src/server
